description: Set the board as ONE change: by default a rectangle round the parts plus margin; or width and height (centred on x, y), or an outline; layers: 2 or 4 copper layers. The answer names parts left outside. Or drawing: the board from a DXF or SVG drawing; the largest closed shape is the outline, circles in it mounting holes, other shapes keepouts; parts are not moved and the answer lists those now outside. A .kicad_pcb instead makes file a new circuit (outline, parts, nets, copper); the answer lists what did not come over. kind "perfboard" or "stripboard": a 2.54 mm hole grid, parts put on holes.

drawing.description: A DXF, SVG (sized in mm, in…) or KiCad board in the project folder, e.g. case.dxf or old.kicad_pcb

dxfLayer.description: DXF: only this layer may make the outline

origin.description: "centre" (default) centres the outline on the origin; "keep" leaves it as drawn

replace.description: Replace the board's holes and keepouts; without it a board that has some is refused

name: fit_board
